queries_run: Fortive 10-K customer concentration no single customer 10% of sales

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：應收帳款因客戶與地理分散，不視為重大信用集中；呆帳準備與信用損失微小。
findings.excerpt: The allowance for doubtful accounts as well as the provision for credit losses, write-off activity and recoveries for the periods presented were immaterial. We do not believe that accounts receivable represent significant concentrations of credit risk because of the diversified portfolio of individual customers and geographical areas.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K MD&A：客戶應收款的信用風險集中度因客戶分散而有限。
findings.excerpt: In addition, concentrations of credit risk arising from receivables from customers are limited due to the diversity of our customers.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋僅見FY2016-2019 10-K有「無客戶逾10%」聲明，FY2025未核到該句；未查到客戶信用惡化事件。
